collectStoryAndReqMetadata(comment) parses the comment body: - Tracks storyLineIndices, reqLineIndices, reqIds, and deduced storyPath. - Requires simple forms only: - @story with exactly MIN_STORY_TOKENS tokens, otherwise storyPath is set to null (bails out of auto-fix). - buildImplementsAutoFix(context, comment, storyPaths) enforces strict preconditions: - Returns null unless storyPaths.size === 1 (exactly one distinct @story path). - After collecting metadata, also requires: - storyLineIndices.length === 1 (exactly one @story line). - reqLineIndices.length >= 1 (at least one @req line). - storyPath !== null (no complex story/req content). - When all conditions are satisfied, builds a fixer via applyImplementsReplacement. - Omits all indices in allIndicesToRemove (the @story and @req lines). - Leaves all other lines untouched and in original order (preserving description, @param, @returns ordering as required by REQ-PRESERVE-FORMAT). - Uses fixer.replaceTextRange across the entire comment range, reconstructing the block as `/*` + fixedValue + `*/` while preserving the existing prefix slice and appending closing `*/` (consistent, valid JSDoc output). hasMultipleStories(storyPaths) combined with MULTI_STORY_THRESHOLD enforces that storyPaths.size > 1 is treated as multi-story. - processComment() specifically reports: - messageId "cannotAutoFix" with a reason when hasImplements is true (mixed @story/@req and @supports), matching the "mixed usage" case from the story. -
